description:
AI-powered UltraStar karaoke package generator (lyric sync, pitch, and BPM detection)

USKMaker generates complete UltraStar Deluxe karaoke packages from a YouTube link or local audio file. It downloads/prepares the audio, separates vocals, aligns your provided lyrics to the singing using local AI (WhisperX + forced alignment), detects pitch and BPM, and writes a ready-to-play UltraStar .txt package - entirely offline after setup, no cloud APIs.
[2.9.0] - 2026-11-20
Adicionado
- Índice de linhas para revisar no fim da geração: o resultado lista as linhas com nota suspeita (estimada ou de confiança baixa), com o minuto de cada uma, até 8, e quantas são no total.
- Confirmar linha na Revisão: botão "Confirmar linha" (atalho K) marca a linha da nota selecionada como conferida. Ela fica verde, sai da contagem de "Linhas suspeitas" (gravado no song_data.json ao salvar; Ctrl+Z desfaz).
Alterado
- CI: a publicação no AUR e na Snap Store passa a ser chamada pelo build do Linux depois de anexar o .deb ao release (o gatilho antigo, release: published, nunca disparava).
[2.9.0] - 2026-11-20
Added
- Index of lines to review at the end of a generation: the result lists the lines with a suspect note (estimated or low confidence), with each one's minute, up to 8, and how many there are in total.
- Confirm line in the Review: a "Confirm line" button (shortcut K) marks the selected note's line as checked. It turns green and leaves the "Suspect lines" count (written to song_data.json on save; Ctrl+Z undoes).
Changed
- CI: publishing to the AUR and the Snap Store is now called by the Linux build after the .deb is attached to the release (the old release: published trigger never fired).
